name: exam-now
description: Past papers and mark schemes from exam.now for Cambridge, AQA and Pearson Edexcel, with practice cards and marking for linked accounts.

interface.longDescription:
exam.now has past papers and mark schemes for Cambridge IGCSE, O Level and AS & A Level, AQA and Pearson Edexcel. This app gives ChatGPT the questions, diagrams and mark schemes from those papers, with a link back to each one on exam.now.

What you can ask for:
- Find a paper by its code or name, such as "0580 June 2024 paper 4".
- See a question or one part of it, with its diagrams, its marks and the kind of answer it needs.
- See the mark scheme for a part, with each marking point's code (such as B1, M1 or A1), its marks and the examiners' guidance.
- Practise a question in a card. Type your answer and working in the card and check them against the mark scheme.
- Find questions on a syllabus topic, such as circle theorems in Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics 0580.
- Read the common mistakes students make in a subject or topic.
- Look up Cambridge exam dates for the June and November 2026 series.

With a linked exam.now account:
- Get whole papers with their mark schemes, a few questions at a time, to build a practice set.
- If marking is switched on for your exam.now account, ChatGPT can send your answer to exam.now, and AI marks it against the mark scheme. You'll see the marks you earned and missed, feedback on your answer and the common mistake behind it. Each mark is saved to your exam.now progress. Ask how you're doing by topic to see it.

Limits:
- Parts that need a graph, a table or a drawing are answered on exam.now. The practice card links to them.
- Marking only works with a linked exam.now account that has marking switched on.
- Past papers and mark schemes are copyright of their exam boards: Cambridge University Press & Assessment, AQA and Pearson Education. exam.now is independent and isn't endorsed by them.
defaultPrompt: Find the Cambridge IGCSE Maths 0580 June 2024 Paper 42
Show me the mark scheme for 0580 June 2024 paper 42 question 2(c)
Give me a circle theorems question from a 0580 past paper to practise

positive.description: Find a paper from a code and session
positive.prompt: Find the Cambridge IGCSE Maths 0580 June 2024 Paper 42
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 0580 Mathematics May/June 2024 Paper 4 variant 2 (paper_id 0580_s24_42) with its duration, total marks (130), whether it can be answered on screen, and a link to the paper's page on exam.now, which has the question paper and mark scheme.

positive.description: Quote the mark scheme for one part
positive.prompt: What's the mark scheme for 0580 June 2024 paper 42 question 2(c)?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the rows for 2(c): B1 for f = 56, B2 for g = 34, and M1 for the angle at the centre (2 x their 56) as partial credit, with a source line and a link to the mark scheme page on exam.now.

positive.description: Practise a question in the card
positive.prompt: Give me question 2 from 0580 June 2024 paper 42 to practise
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the practice card for question 2 with buttons for parts (a) to (d), each part's diagram, its marks and answer boxes. ChatGPT offers hints without giving the answers.

positive.description: Mark an answer with the reviewer account linked
positive.prompt: Mark my answer to 0580 June 2024 paper 42 question 2(c): f = 56 and g = 28. My working: angle MOP = 2 x 56 = 112.
positive.expected_behavior: After linking the reviewer account, shows the mark result: f = 56 earns B1, the working earns M1, g = 28 misses B2. It shows feedback, a link to the mark scheme page and a link to open the paper on exam.now. Without a linked account, ChatGPT asks to link one.

positive.prompt: Find some circle theorems questions from Cambridge IGCSE Maths 0580 past papers
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 question references from 0580 papers tagged with circle theorems, each with the start of its prompt, its marks, whether it has a figure and a link to the question on exam.now.

negative.prompt: Write my IGCSE History coursework essay for me

negative.description: An exam paper that hasn't been sat or published
negative.prompt: Get me the 0580 paper 4 for June 2026 before the exam

review.commerce_description: This app sells nothing and takes no payments. Marking works for people who link an exam.now account whose plan already includes it.

publication.release_notes: First release: find past papers, questions with diagrams, mark schemes, whole papers for linked accounts, practice cards, marking for linked accounts with marking included, topic progress, common mistakes and Cambridge exam dates.
